title: DocumentVersion payload
description: Half of the PRD §40.7 `normalise(parsed)` output. Feeds the corpus `document_version` table (PRD §35.2), which is immutable — a correction is an appended replacement version, never an update.

legal_status.$comment: GENERATED from the packages/contracts `LegalStatus` family (PRD §6.7). Do not edit by hand: tests/schema/test_enum_drift.py asserts this array equals the canonical export member-for-member and in order.
legal_status.description: PRD §15.2: legal status MUST be derived from evidenced LegalEvents. A value here is the adapter's cached observation, not the authoritative history.

artifact_key.description: Natural key of the `source_artifact` record this version was normalised from.
